lines.key: ARCHIVIST�I am at the museum service desk. This receiver stays on my channel while you are in the reconstruction.
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: I am at the museum service desk. This receiver stays on my channel while you are in the reconstruction.

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�Echo City is still running its nine thirty p.m. municipal closing round. The station lighting circuit is off, so take the canvas kit and restore night power first.
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: Echo City is still running its nine thirty p.m. municipal closing round. The station lighting circuit is off, so take the canvas kit and restore night power first.

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�After the street lamps return, draw the final market stall curtains, restart the fountain pump, and return the public-works ledger.
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: After the street lamps return, draw the final market stall curtains, restart the fountain pump, and return the public-works ledger.

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�Correct. Nothing here is hidden. Walk the city and finish what the night attendant would have finished.
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: Correct. Nothing here is hidden. Walk the city and finish what the night attendant would have finished.

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�That is intentional. Follow the dim platform marker and open the station breaker first. The rest of the route will be easier once the street grid is back.
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: That is intentional. Follow the dim platform marker and open the station breaker first. The rest of the route will be easier once the street grid is back.

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�The last stall is covered. Vendors tied their own curtains; the night attendant checked the final row.
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: The last stall is covered. Vendors tied their own curtains; the night attendant checked the final row.

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�Circulation restored. The pump stayed on overnight so mineral deposits did not harden in the basin.
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: Circulation restored. The pump stayed on overnight so mineral deposits did not harden in the basin.

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�Ledger returned and stamped. Most city records are ordinary: repairs, late keys, borrowed tools, and small mistakes.
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: Ledger returned and stamped. Most city records are ordinary: repairs, late keys, borrowed tools, and small mistakes.

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�The return slot opened a second tray. There is a night-service badge inside. Take it before you leave.
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: The return slot opened a second tray. There is a night-service badge inside. Take it before you leave.

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�It belonged to the attendant whose round you just finished. The museum catalogued the work orders, but not the worker.
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: It belonged to the attendant whose round you just finished. The museum catalogued the work orders, but not the worker.

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�Bring the badge back. It should be displayed with the record.
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: Bring the badge back. It should be displayed with the record.

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�Station lamp on. The closing circuit is checking the line.
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: Station lamp on. The closing circuit is checking the line.

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�That was the night clerk’s service window. The last tram has gone; you can switch it off.
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: That was the night clerk’s service window. The last tram has gone; you can switch it off.

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�The timetable slipped in its frame. Set it upright for the morning crew.
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: The timetable slipped in its frame. Set it upright for the morning crew.

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�That standpipe fed the fountain crew’s hose. Close it before water freezes on the pavement.
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: That standpipe fed the fountain crew’s hose. Close it before water freezes on the pavement.

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�The night round is complete. The museum doorway is connected again.
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: The night round is complete. The museum doorway is connected again.

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�Walk back through the city. The four places you serviced will remain in their finished state.
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: Walk back through the city. The four places you serviced will remain in their finished state.

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�The museum doorway is offline while the closing round is open. The service kit lists the four remaining jobs.
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: The museum doorway is offline while the closing round is open. The service kit lists the four remaining jobs.

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�Before you go, can you hear me over the transformer hum?
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: Before you go, can you hear me over the transformer hum?

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�It is a borrowed receiver. If it gets worse, use the spare earpiece in the side pocket.
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: It is a borrowed receiver. If it gets worse, use the spare earpiece in the side pocket.

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�That is where the museum stored it. I cleaned the part that touches your ear.
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: That is where the museum stored it. I cleaned the part that touches your ear.

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�No answer usually means it works. Tap the receiver once if it cuts out.
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: No answer usually means it works. Tap the receiver once if it cuts out.

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�The curtain winch sticks in damp weather. Do not force it past the stop.
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: The curtain winch sticks in damp weather. Do not force it past the stop.

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�Three repair tickets from the same stall. The last attendant underlined “do not force.”
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: Three repair tickets from the same stall. The last attendant underlined “do not force.”

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�She asked the city twice. Procurement closed both requests.
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: She asked the city twice. Procurement closed both requests.

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�Stop when the canvas edges meet. The old handle can keep its dignity.
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: Stop when the canvas edges meet. The old handle can keep its dignity.

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�Check the basin before you start the pump. Anything caught in the grate?
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: Check the basin before you start the pump. Anything caught in the grate?

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�Take out the cup. Leave the coins. Maintenance stopped arguing about those in 1987.
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: Take out the cup. Leave the coins. Maintenance stopped arguing about those in 1987.

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�Then the filter can take it. Your gloves will smell like the fountain either way.
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: Then the filter can take it. Your gloves will smell like the fountain either way.

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�If the grate is clear, start it. Do not put your hand under the impeller.
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: If the grate is clear, start it. Do not put your hand under the impeller.

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�Keep the ledger flat. The binding was repaired last winter.
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: Keep the ledger flat. The binding was repaired last winter.

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�Public works used thick paper. They expected the records to outlive the pipes.
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: Public works used thick paper. They expected the records to outlive the pipes.

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�Night staff used whatever paper was in front of them. Do not erase it.
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: Night staff used whatever paper was in front of them. Do not erase it.

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�Both hands, please. The corner already came off once.
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: Both hands, please. The corner already came off once.

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�The station lamp takes twenty seconds to warm. If it flickers once, leave it alone.
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: The station lamp takes twenty seconds to warm. If it flickers once, leave it alone.

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�Two cleaners and a bakery driver, most nights. The car was often late; the schedule still mattered.
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: Two cleaners and a bakery driver, most nights. The car was often late; the schedule still mattered.

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�Then use the other end. The city has been repainting that bench since before Mara crossed.
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: Then use the other end. The city has been repainting that bench since before Mara crossed.

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�Give the lamp time. Old fluorescent tubes dislike being watched.
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: Give the lamp time. Old fluorescent tubes dislike being watched.

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�Do you want the receiver off for the walk back?
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: Do you want the receiver off for the walk back?

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�All right. I can stay on the line. You do not have to report anything.
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: All right. I can stay on the line. You do not have to report anything.

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�Of course. The door lights will lead you back.
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: Of course. The door lights will lead you back.

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�I will leave the channel open. No need to answer.
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: I will leave the channel open. No need to answer.

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�Next stop: the market shutters. You can find it on the service map.
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: Next stop: the market shutters. You can find it on the service map.

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�Next stop: the fountain pump. You can find it on the service map.
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: Next stop: the fountain pump. You can find it on the service map.

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�Next stop: the archive ledger. You can find it on the service map.
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: Next stop: the archive ledger. You can find it on the service map.

lines.key: ARCHIVIST�Next stop: the night-service badge. You can find it on the service map.
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST
lines.text: Next stop: the night-service badge. You can find it on the service map.

lines.key: BUTCH�So this is maintenance, not another test.
lines.speaker: BUTCH
lines.text: So this is maintenance, not another test.

lines.key: BUTCH�One service key, one ledger, and a hand lamp. The hand lamp is barely enough to see the pavement.
lines.speaker: BUTCH
lines.text: One service key, one ledger, and a hand lamp. The hand lamp is barely enough to see the pavement.

lines.key: BUTCH�Someone always had to stay five minutes later.
lines.speaker: BUTCH
lines.text: Someone always had to stay five minutes later.

lines.key: BUTCH�In the daytime, people met here. At night, somebody still had to keep the water moving.
lines.speaker: BUTCH
lines.text: In the daytime, people met here. At night, somebody still had to keep the water moving.

lines.key: BUTCH�That sounds more like a city than the museum labels do.
lines.speaker: BUTCH
lines.text: That sounds more like a city than the museum labels do.

lines.key: BUTCH�NIGHT SERVICE. A-17. The brass is worn where someone held it between two fingers.
lines.speaker: BUTCH
lines.text: NIGHT SERVICE. A-17. The brass is worn where someone held it between two fingers.

lines.key: BUTCH�When Mara crossed Echo City, people were lowering shutters, returning books, cleaning stone, and waiting for the last car.
lines.speaker: BUTCH
lines.text: When Mara crossed Echo City, people were lowering shutters, returning books, cleaning stone, and waiting for the last car.

lines.key: BUTCH�She was not moving through a case file. She was moving through other people’s evening.
lines.speaker: BUTCH
lines.text: She was not moving through a case file. She was moving through other people’s evening.

lines.key: BUTCH�Someone left the light on so late passengers could still ask for help.
lines.speaker: BUTCH
lines.text: Someone left the light on so late passengers could still ask for help.

lines.key: BUTCH�There. First service at six ten. Nothing mysterious about it.
lines.speaker: BUTCH
lines.text: There. First service at six ten. Nothing mysterious about it.

lines.key: BUTCH�Valve closed. The drip has stopped.
lines.speaker: BUTCH
lines.text: Valve closed. The drip has stopped.

lines.key: BUTCH�Loud and clear. The left channel clicks.
lines.speaker: BUTCH
lines.text: Loud and clear. The left channel clicks.

lines.key: BUTCH�I can hear you. The earpiece smells like a coat closet.
lines.speaker: BUTCH
lines.text: I can hear you. The earpiece smells like a coat closet.

lines.key: BUTCH�How do you know?
lines.speaker: BUTCH
lines.text: How do you know?

lines.key: BUTCH�The vendor could fix it.
lines.speaker: BUTCH
lines.text: The vendor could fix it.

lines.key: BUTCH�A paper cup and two coins.
lines.speaker: BUTCH
lines.text: A paper cup and two coins.

lines.key: BUTCH�Only wet leaves.
lines.speaker: BUTCH
lines.text: Only wet leaves.

lines.key: BUTCH�It is heavier than it looks.
lines.speaker: BUTCH
lines.text: It is heavier than it looks.

lines.key: BUTCH�Someone wrote a grocery list in the margin.
lines.speaker: BUTCH
lines.text: Someone wrote a grocery list in the margin.

lines.key: BUTCH�Did anyone wait here this late?
lines.speaker: BUTCH
lines.text: Did anyone wait here this late?

lines.key: BUTCH�The bench paint is still tacky.
lines.speaker: BUTCH
lines.text: The bench paint is still tacky.

lines.key: BUTCH�Leave it on.
lines.speaker: BUTCH
lines.text: Leave it on.

lines.key: BUTCH�Give me a minute of quiet.
lines.speaker: BUTCH
lines.text: Give me a minute of quiet.
